paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Tehillim, chapter 72. Hyman considers this a scribal error and says it should read “ben Chalafta.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: מד׳ תהלים פ״עב is read contextually as Midrash Tehillim chapter 72; the initial mem is part of the supplied label, not silently detached. No named edition is independently checked.

Tachlifa to Chalafta is Hyman’s correction. ט״ס is conventionally scribal error and צ״ל means should read; this does not establish when or how an error arose, or independently admit the corrected identity. The personal title remains R'.
